insights: 9,498 streamers share 153,138 mutual follows — density 0.0034: only ~0.34% of possible pairs are connected (a sparse network).
Small world: any two streamers in the giant component are on average 2.756 hops apart (diameter ≥ 7).
Heavy-tailed degree: the top 1% of streamers hold 19% of all tie endpoints (max degree 4259 vs median 15).
Partner assortativity = -0.252: verified Partners connect across Partner status more than within it.
Degree assortativity = -0.115: big hubs tend to link with small creators (hub-and-spoke / mentoring pattern).
Louvain found 11 communities (modularity 0.29); the largest, C1, holds 19% of streamers.
C4 is the most 'professional' community: 8% Partners vs 6% overall.
C7 has the highest share of mature-content streamers (78% vs 60% overall) — content style clusters in the network.
187 'hidden gems' sit in the top 15% by network centrality yet below median views — well-connected creators the audience hasn't found yet.
425 'bridges' have most of their ties outside their own community — natural brokers for cross-community collaborations.
